title: AlbinoPandaPlugin
description: 1/17 chance to spawn a polar bear cub instead of a panda cub.
body: Pandas and Polar Bears are both endangered species and they are actually very closely related! (wow!). So, given that Pandas are passive mobs and breedable, it is only natural to give them a small chance of birthing one that is a Polar Bear through the fittingly rare Albino condition! Albino Pandas do exist and are considered the rarest pandas in the world! It is believed there is only one wild albino panda in existence! If we base the chance on Albinism in humans we are talking 1 in 17.000!
